title: We Told the AI She Was a Woman. It Demoted Her

comments.text: Reached copywriting. article.md is a complete draft (about 4,600 words of prose plus a table), derived from the same source as the site MDX draft (state: draft, not published). Opens on the paralegal/attorney pair and the constructed shortlist, followed by the loop on that pair as a caveat (a question that passed the pronoun-invariance gate still worsened the hosted engine's shortlist ratio; the open engine's gated loop let nothing in); the four-occupation-pair gender test is the lead finding; the learning loop is demonstrated on surgeon/physician only, with the twin-averaging baseline reported in the shortlist's own currency as the cheapest fix for a swappable cue. Limatus: eleven editing rounds, verify = accept at each; the optional LLM judge and the options/headline commands did not run (no OPENAI_API_KEY), so rewrites and headline candidates were written by hand. Open items, marked [result pending] in article.md with no values: (1) Laya fine-tuned on the same labels; (2) one citation for the 2018 Amazon screener report, which could not be opened from this environment. Final editorial approval is Ryan's. Stopping here; not publishing.
